scope: lease renewal and remote execution fencing
host ingress ownership, TLS and rollback
remaining_boundaries: Initial external npm dependency resolution is not shipped as a complete lockfile; installed bytes are recorded and immutable reuse is checked.
Abnormal remote execution retains unresolved intent. There is no automatic safe-liveness inference or native intent recovery entry yet.
Direct administrative commands outside the managed lease contract and intentionally detached late writes are outside execution fencing.
A single physical server remains one failure domain.
production: Host platform and Consumer acceptance pending; EXAMPLE app-only release accepted separately.
